hooks.name: Block writes to .env files
hooks.description: Secrets stay in the owner's .env. The agent edits .env.example and src/env.js instead.

action.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const e=JSON.parse(d);const p=JSON.stringify(e.tool_input||{});if(/(^|[\\/\"'])\.env(\.local|\.production)?[\"']/.test(p)){console.error('Do not write to .env. Edit .env.example and src/env.js, and tell the owner which value to set.');process.exit(2)}})"
